items.headline: PINT AE Billing v1.0.5 is final and changes validation outcomes for some UAE eInvoice documents; ASPs and integrators should update and retest.
FTA Public Clarification VATP048 explains supplier-verification evidence needed to protect input VAT recovery where tax evasion is established.
The FTA has comprehensively revised its Corporate Tax Groups guide, including eligibility, aggregated financial statements, tax losses and ongoing compliance.
The Ministry of Finance register now lists 88 fully accredited UAE eInvoicing service providers, expanding the available provider market for implementation.
Cabinet Decision No. 173 of 2026 introduces revised UAE eInvoicing penalties, including AED 5,000 for initial implementation non-compliance and capped continuing penalties.
Ministerial Decision No. 197 of 2026 temporarily excludes intra-VAT-group transactions from eInvoicing and removes the UAE data-storage-location requirement, effective 1 October 2026.
